speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The children are asleep. Do not go up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not go up. The book and the song are heard. I am not making a ceremony of a goodbye.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I am in the door. That is the whole of the seeing-off. Thy father is in his bed, and he has the sense to stay there.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The bay has had eleven days' grass and is no sweeter for it. Thy knot is on the pack. If it slips I will tie it as thou tied it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Tie it so, and do not improve it. The tables stay shut today. I am not asking the question.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing on the tables. Four shillings should come home. I am not opening the rag to argue with it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Good. Do not name a sum in the lane for me to carry. Shut the gate.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am gone. Stay for the turning, and no longer.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I will be in the door until the lane hides thee. Write nothing.
